source: Adapted cross-reference, September 2026: Wikipedia's list of past performers, the festival's own site and YouTube titles (2026 bill), sonar.es on ARTE at Sónar 2024, Deep House Amsterdam on Laurent Garnier and RBMA, Commons photographs of named performers. This site's catalogue (source 6 of FIGURES.md) holds 13 sets that mention Sónar, none from the festival itself; four are Beatport's OFFSónar streams. Players come from official broadcast partners' channels (ARTE Concert, Resident Advisor, DJ Mag), checked by YouTube oEmbed author and watch-page data (playable, embeddable, view count) on 14 September 2026. Fan uploads rejected even where they are the most viewed.
